At Point of Flat Purchase: You have disposed of the existing flat or private residential property, and do not own any HDB flat
Conditions to Take a Second HDB Housing: You and all members of the core family nucleus must use the CPF refund and up to 50% of the cash proceeds received from the disposal of the last-owned HDB flat, or private residential property disposed of at least 30 months before your HFE letter application. This shall be based on the legal completion date of the disposal. You may retain up to $20,000 in your CPF Ordinary Account (OA) and use the remaining balance in your OA to buy the flat.

At Point of Flat Purchase: You are buying an HDB flat before disposing of the existing one
Conditions to Take a Second HDB Housing: You will be charged commercial interest rate for the housing loan to buy the next flat. The interest rate will be converted to the concessionary rate after you have disposed of the existing flat, within 6 months from the date of legal completion of the flat purchase, and used the CPF refund and up to 50% of the cash proceeds received from the disposal to redeem the housing loan for the next flat. From the CPF monies refunded, you may retain up to $20,000 in your CPF OA .
